about_the_game:
Play With Heart. Win With Happiness.

Step into the sparkly world of Pokerii, a kawaii roguelike deckbuilder where happiness is your ultimate goal!

Play powerful hands, form emotional connections between your cards, and collect adorable pets and tasty treats to build the perfect run. Every match is a heartfelt showdown packed with strategy, charm, and cozy vibes.

About Pokerii

Inspired by poker but reimagined through a magical, emotional lens, Pokerii invites you to create happiness through strategy, connection, and charm. Hands aren't just hands—they're friendships. Synergies aren't just combos—they’re connections. Whether you're boosting your happiness with cupcakes or building bonds between chibi card avatars, every choice adds up to a uniquely wholesome journey.

Features

  • Kawaii Poker Mechanics: Combine cards to play classic poker hands—or reach for “Connection Hands,” powerful synergies based on the emotional bond (and total rank) between cards.

  • Build Your Own Joy: Draft adorable pets and tasty foods to power up your run. Each one boosts your happiness or adds special effects that change the way you play.

  • Emotional Combos: Discover a variety of heartfelt effects and card upgrades that reward smart planning, daring plays, and deep connections.

  • Wholesome Roguelike Runs: Navigate dreamy activities and face quirky opponents like Knitting and Sleeping, and try to make it through each Emotion Wave while growing your deck and happiness score.

  • Vibrant Visual Style: Set against a dreamy, hand-crafted world full of pastel swirls, cozy creatures, and playful charm, Pokerii offers a feel-good visual experience from start to finish.

A Different Kind of Power Fantasy

In Pokerii, victory isn’t about domination—it’s about expression, care, and joy. Whether you’re aiming for a perfect combo or just trying to cheer up a sleepy cloud, you’ll find delight in every round, every card, and every spark of happiness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240 (2 * 3400); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1024 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: The kawaii poker roguelike. Pokerii is a cozy deckbuilder where your cards form friendships and emotional connections, unlocking powerful combos and happiness-boosting effects. Collect adorable pets and tasty foods to grow even stronger with every round.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
